evidence: The films were deposited using either lithium tert-butoxide (LiO tBu) or lithium hexamethyldisilazide [LiHMDS, Li(N(SiMe3)2)] as lithium sources while trimethyl phosphate [TMPO, (MeO)3PO] was applied as a phosphate source. Nitrogen was produced with a domnick hunter G2100E nitrogen generator and used as a carrier and a purging gas.
